title: Jammy Juicy Kenyan Vermicelli Noodles
description: A comforting Kenyan dish featuring vermicelli rice noodles, broiled to bring out their natural jamminess. Best enjoyed with a side of steamed vegetables.
instructions: Preheat the molcajete over medium heat.
Add 1 tsp of sesame oil and swirl it around to coat the bottom.
Add the chicken breast and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until it is browned and cooked through.
Add 2 tbsp of soy sauce, 1 tbsp of honey, 1 tbsp of lime juice, 3 cloves of minced garlic, and 1 inch piece of grated ginger to the molcajete.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add 250g of vermicelli noodles to the molcajete and stir to combine with the sauce.
Transfer the molcajete to the oven and broil for 2-3 minutes, or until the noodles are lightly browned and crispy.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
